description: This is a Java test class for the EngineChartParser component, containing unit tests for parsing engine waveform data, duty cycles, and revolution logs.

classes.name: EngineChartParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the EngineChartParser functionalities related to parsing engine waveform data and duty cycles.

methods.name: testMultiParser
methods.description: Tests the parsing of an empty engine chart string and a more complex wave data string, verifying the map size and UpDown list contents.

methods.name: testDutyCycle
methods.description: Validates parsing of a detailed wave string with injector and spark signals, including comparison of crank revolution logs and duty cycle calculations.

methods.name: testUpOnly
methods.description: Checks the parsing of a string with only 'up' events to ensure it results in an empty list.
